purpose: A post-breakout deep undercut whose low reaches the line but whose close plunges below it and never reclaims within h_hold: NOT a valid retest, and it qualifies as FAILED_BREAKOUT.
category: deep undercut not a valid retest

rejection_rationale.candidate: RETEST_HELD at t=20 (treating the dip as a successful retest)
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The return condition is met (low reached the line) but the HOLD condition fails: the close does NOT reclaim the line within eps_retest, and it does not reclaim within h_hold=3 bars either.
rejection_rationale.numeric: Return: ln(L[20])=ln(76.00)=4.330733 <= y_hat(20)+eps_retest=4.402114 (dipped). Hold FAILS: ln(C[20])=ln(77.00)=4.343805 < y_hat(20)-eps_retest=4.382114; and t=21 (ln76=4.330733) and t=22 (ln75=4.317488) also stay below y_hat-eps_retest -> no reclaim within h_hold.

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: The close at t=20 is below line-eps_fail within F_fail bars, so FAILED_BREAKOUT fires.

key_inequalities: t=20 low reaches the line (return true) but close 77 is far below line-eps_retest (hold false).
No reclaim within h_hold=3 bars (t=20,21,22 all close below line-eps_retest).
Close below line-eps_fail within F_fail -> FAILED_BREAKOUT, explicitly NOT RETESTED.
geometry_check.notes: Contrast with GX-04: same geometry and return-to-line, but the close fails the 'hold as support' test. Distinguishes a genuine retest (§16) from a breakdown (§15).
